Mezze & Mortar — Baking

Blueberry Scones
Posted by Lejla Vuković · 18 June 2025

Ingredients
- 320 g plain flour
- 70 g caster sugar
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 90 g cold butter, cubed
- 150 ml buttermilk
- 125 g blueberries
- 1 tsp lemon zest

Method
1. Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray.
2. Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and baking powder until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Stir in the lemon zest and blueberries. Add the buttermilk and mix just until the dough comes together.
4. Pat into a round, cut into eight wedges and place on the tray.
5. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until lightly golden. Cool on the tray for five minutes.
